drivers.name: OpenRuntime.efi
drivers.description: OpenCore runtime services. Required on every UEFI build. Never disable.

drivers.name: OpenHfsPlus.efi
drivers.description: Reads HFS+ volumes so the macOS installer and recovery appear in the picker. Ships in the OpenCore zip.

drivers.name: ResetNvramEntry.efi
drivers.description: Adds Reset NVRAM to the picker. Needed after BIOS or quirk changes. Press Spacebar if HideAuxiliary is on.

drivers.name: OpenCanopy.efi
drivers.description: Graphical OpenCore picker. Must match the OpenCore.efi version and needs OcBinaryData Resources.

drivers.name: AudioDxe.efi
drivers.description: Boot chime / picker audio. Not a replacement for AppleALC in macOS.

drivers.name: FirmwareSettingsEntry.efi
drivers.description: Adds a picker entry that reboots into firmware setup.

drivers.name: ToggleSipEntry.efi
drivers.description: Adds a picker entry to toggle SIP. Leave off unless you are debugging.

drivers.name: OpenLinuxBoot.efi
drivers.description: Boots Linux from the OpenCore picker. Usually paired with Ext4Dxe or OpenNtfsDxe.

drivers.name: OpenNtfsDxe.efi
drivers.description: Reads NTFS volumes so Windows partitions can appear in the picker.

drivers.name: Ext4Dxe.efi
drivers.description: Reads ext4 Linux volumes. Enable with OpenLinuxBoot if you dual-boot Linux.

drivers.name: OpenPartitionDxe.efi
drivers.description: Adds partition-driver support some dual-boot layouts need.

drivers.name: NvmExpressDxe.efi
drivers.description: NVMe driver for firmware that cannot see NVMe disks. Leave off if the BIOS already enumerates the drive.

drivers.name: XhciDxe.efi
drivers.description: XHCI USB driver for older firmware missing native XHCI. Modern UEFI boards already have this.

drivers.name: OpenUsbKbDxe.efi
drivers.description: USB keyboard for legacy CSM/Duet only. Enabling this on a real UEFI board often breaks the picker keyboard.
drivers.warning: Do not enable on UEFI Dell/X99. Breaks keyboard input on many boards.

drivers.name: UsbMouseDxe.efi
drivers.description: USB mouse for legacy firmware. Not needed on modern UEFI.

drivers.name: Ps2KeyboardDxe.efi
drivers.description: PS/2 keyboard in the picker. Only for boards that still use a PS/2 port at boot.

drivers.name: Ps2MouseDxe.efi
drivers.description: PS/2 mouse in the picker. Rarely needed.

drivers.name: HiiDatabase.efi
drivers.description: HII database for firmware that lacks one. Needed by some AudioDxe setups.

drivers.name: CrScreenshotDxe.efi
drivers.description: F10 screenshot of the picker, written to the EFI partition. Useful when debugging boot.

drivers.name: OpenVariableRuntimeDxe.efi
drivers.description: Emulated NVRAM. LoadEarly must be true and it must load before OpenRuntime. Only for firmware that cannot write NVRAM.
drivers.warning: If enabled, LoadEarly must be true and OpenRuntime must follow it.

drivers.name: ResetTSCAdjust.efi
drivers.description: Historical TSC fix used in some T5810 GitHub EFIs. OpenCore 1.0.x does not ship this file. Enabling it without the binary halts boot. Use CpuTscSync.kext instead.
drivers.warning: Missing file = OpenCore HaltLevel ERROR. Leave disabled. CpuTscSync.kext is the 1.0.x path.
